title: vibeX links: how services call each other

repo.description: Name given to --repo name=dir. Omit in a monorepo and use root-relative paths.

spec.description: Id of this service's endpoints spec. Lets vibex list endpoints nothing calls.

external.description: Not your code (Stripe, a supplier). Its side of a link needs no anchor.

c4.description: "<c4 spec id>#<element id>" for every element that draws this service. Enables the C4 drift check.

ignore.description: Path patterns left out of "nothing calls": "/actuator/**", "/swagger-ui/*". * stays in one segment, ** crosses them.

links.description: One entry per call. In-process calls are not links.

route.description: What is called: "POST /orders", "mutation createOrder", a topic name

env.description: Config key holding the target address, e.g. ORDER_API_URL

auth.description: How the caller authenticates, in a few words

endpoint.description: "<spec id>#<endpoint id>" in the target's endpoints spec, or a list when one templated call reaches several

client.description: The calling code. Required unless `from` is external.

handler.description: The code that serves it. Required unless `to` is external.

shared_ids.description: Identifiers one service owns and others store or pass along.

label.description: The name in code, e.g. orderId

refs.description: "<spec id>#<node id>" where it lives, e.g. an ERD column's entity

positions.description: Boxes pinned where someone dragged them in the viewer: id -> [x, y], the box's top-left corner. Written by "vibex layout" from the viewer's Save layout.
